newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer-"healthy" mkt correction after Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer-"healthy" mkt correction after Greenspan.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer on Thursday said markets showed a short-term fall in reaction to comments by Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan but had then corrected in the following week, and that overall this was a "healthy development".
Asked whether he agreed with comments made by Greenspan which unsettled financial markets earlier this month, Tietmeyer declined to comment directly.
But he said: "Markets showed a short-term reaction but then in the following week saw a certain correction. Overall it was a healthy development."

Greenspan unsettled markets earlier this month after he wondered aloud in a speech whether U.S. asset prices were too high. Greenspan also noted that while current inflation levels were fine, their future course was unclear.
